trap.label: present perfect cont.
trap.wrong: They are talking for two hours.
trap.right: They have been talking for two hours.
trap.why: O português usa o presente (“conversam há duas horas”). Em inglês, ação que começou no passado e continua pede have been + -ing.

opts: She has been waiting since noon.

fix.right: They have been talking for two hours.
She has been waiting since noon.
